title: primula hirsuta subsp. graveolens
intro: Primula hirsuta subsp. graveolens, commonly known as a flowering plant, is a subspecies of Primula hirsuta. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Primula hirsuta subsp. graveolens include treating various respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, as well as soothing digestive problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
